create_Variable: create a Variable from a torch tensor with an optional name for differentiable optimization
update_Variable: update a Variable tensor with new data using an optional batch ignore mask
copy_Variable: copy a Variable to create a new independent Variable with a cloned tensor
use_as_variable: wrap a float, list, or tensor into a Variable using the as_variable helper function
use_masked_variables: use the masked_variables context manager to temporarily apply a boolean mask to a list of Variables
